title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
lineage: TDK-MA > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain SRC > Wavelab (adding 16-bit patches) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F.
source: AUD: FOB, Sennheiser 441's > Sony TC-D5 > MAC > (likely) 1st Gen, from the Brian Schley tape collection;

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording of an ’82 show with a stunning “He’s Gone” and a beautiful “Stella Blue”, though the band sounds a bit fatigued.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a solid, clear sound that most listeners describe as crisp and enjoyable. Musically the night shines on “He’s Gone” and “Stella Blue,” but several reviewers note a tired vibe and rough vocals from Jerry, giving the performance a mixed energy overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Three out of four reviews are very positive (4‑5 stars) praising the recording and highlight songs, while one review (2 stars) criticizes the band’s performance; weighted average yields a strong but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners repeatedly call the sound great and crisp with no major drop‑outs or distortion mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows well with emotional peaks, though some feel the band sounded fatigued and a bit sloppy at times.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rough, sore‑throat vocals noted by one reviewer; praised for beautiful delivery on Stella Blue and strong guitar tone elsewhere.
band_member_comments.Bob: Flubbed lyrics mentioned alongside Jerry’s vocal issues.
